title: Reporting & Breakdowns
objectives: Use Meta Ads Manager's 'Breakdown' menu to dissect performance
Analyze data across Placement, Age, Gender, Device, and Region
Locate where budget is leaking and eliminate unprofitable segments

blocks.text: Top media buyers don't just look at overall numbers. They peel back the layers to see the hidden truth!
The 'Breakdown' button in Ads Manager lets you split your results by Placement (Reels vs Feed), Demographics (Age & Gender), Device (Android vs iOS), or Time (Day/Week).

blocks.title: The Leaking Bucket Analogy
blocks.text: Your overall campaign looks like it has a ₹150 CPL. But when you look at breakdowns, you find that Instagram Reels is crushing it at ₹100, while Audience Network is burning money at ₹600! Fix the leak and average CPL instantly drops.
In India, mobile Android accounts for over 85% of traffic. Check device breakdown: if iOS CPM is 3x higher without delivering sales, consider testing Android-only ad sets.
Never disable placements prematurely based on just ₹50 of spend. Wait until a placement has spent at least 2x target CPL before cutting it.

quiz.q: What tool in Ads Manager reveals whether Instagram Reels is performing better than Facebook Feed?
quiz.explain: The 'Breakdown by Placement' menu segments impressions, spend, and results across all feeds, Reels, and stories.

quiz.q: Your campaign breakdown shows that women aged 25-34 generate leads at ₹80 CPL, while women aged 18-20 cost ₹350 CPL. What action should you take?
options: Adjust your ad set age targeting to 22-45 to concentrate budget on the profitable demographic
Double the budget on the 18-20 age group
quiz.explain: Eliminating the unprofitable age bracket concentrates your spend where conversions are cheap and qualified.

quiz.q: True or False: Breakdown reporting lets you see performance divided by specific Indian states (e.g. Maharashtra vs Karnataka).
quiz.explain: True! The 'Breakdown by Region' report displays state-level performance across all campaigns.

quiz.q: Why is Audience Network often checked for budget leaks in lead generation campaigns?
options: It only shows ads in foreign languages
It can sometimes deliver accidental clicks inside mobile games with low conversion rates
quiz.explain: Audience Network often delivers accidental clicks on third-party gaming apps with high bounce rates.

recap: Use Breakdown reporting (Placement, Age, Device, Region) to uncover hidden leaks.
Cut low-converting segments to immediately lower your blended Cost Per Result.
